subject: Acme procurement - weekly check-in / PO vs card / marketplace path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@acme.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps from today's discovery call (procurement path)

Hi Sara / Tom -

Thanks again for the time today - great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

- Goal: get Redwood inference running for Acme's product-search reranking workflow (pilot + prod).
- Procurement preference noted: team wants to confirm whether we'll be on a PO (standard for Acme) vs. company card for initial pilot.
- Marketplace interest: Tom mentioned Acme uses the AWS Marketplace for some purchases but procurement would prefer a PO if discounts/terms needed.
- Documents requested by procurement: SOW, standard invoice template, SOC2 evidence, and contact for billing.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll send an SOW draft and invoice template by EOD tomorrow.
2) Rishi will share a short tech note on data residency and onboarding steps for procurement.
3) If procurement wants a marketplace route, we can introduce our marketplace sales rep - otherwise we'll proceed on a PO path and outline contract milestones.

Where it usually gets stuck: budget owner signatures and finance PO processing. If you can confirm the approver and expected PO turnaround, that'll help us coordinate timing.

Attachments: Redwood-SOW-Acme-v1.pdf (draft), SOC2-report-2025.pdf (summary)

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's discovery call (procurement path)

Thanks Marissa - helpful recap. A few clarifications from procurement's side: 

- Procurement preference: PO for anything over $10k. For pilot under $10k we can sometimes use a company procurement card but need CC approval. Likely will be a PO.
- Approver: Finance Director (Tom Reyes) + Legal for standard T&Cs.
- Timeline: Once SOW + invoice are in our system, procurement typically takes 7-10 business days for a routine PO. If Legal has redlines it can add 1-2 weeks.
- Marketplace: We use AWS Marketplace for some software, but only when the vendor offers equivalent commercial terms. Not a blocker but could simplify invoicing.

Please include: invoice remit-to address, our SOW with milestones, and a contact for your billing team. If you can send a clean SOW and invoice template I'll open the procurement ticket.

Thanks,
Sara Lin
Senior Procurement Partner | Acme Corp

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: onboarding notes for procurement

Hi Sara - quick note on technical procurement questions that sometimes come up:
- Data residency: we can host in us-west-2 and provide audit logs.
- Billing: invoice needs remit-to + PO number; we support NET30 by default for PO orders (subject to credit checks for large deals).
- Marketplace: if you go via AWS Marketplace, billing is through Marketplace and terms differ; it can be faster for procurement but may restrict custom terms.

Happy to join a short provider/procurement call if helpful.

Best,
Rishi
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks - appreciate the nudge back if there's anything blocking on our side.
